hooks.name: publish-guard
hooks.description: Keep internal research material and API keys out of the public repository

action.prompt: This file looks like internal material that must not be in the public repository: raw deep-research reports, review packets, run logs, the research kit guide (it contains team member names), or a secrets file. Do not commit it. Tell the user which file it is and ask them to move it outside the repository. If it is a .env file, make sure it is listed in .gitignore and that no API key (for example a 국가법령정보센터 OC value or a Congress.gov api_key) appears in tracked files.
